policy: Fill only currently empty bilingual etiology fields for five gastrointestinal Conditions. Preserve existing pathology, risks, red flags, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append direct government sources. Distinguish triggers, mechanisms, risk factors, and similarly named disorders without overstating uncertain causal pathways.

cond.acute_gastroenteritis.etiology_zh: 急性腸胃炎是一組急性胃腸道症候群，最常由可經糞口途徑傳播的病毒引起，例如諾羅病毒、輪狀病毒、腺病毒與星狀病毒；感染者的糞便或嘔吐物微粒可經人際接觸、受污染的食物、水或表面進入口腔。細菌（如 Salmonella、Campylobacter、Shigella 或致病性 E. coli）與寄生蟲也可造成感染性腸胃炎；另有些食源性發作是攝入細菌預先形成的毒素或化學污染物所致，不等於腸道內活菌侵襲。病原與毒力因子決定分泌型水瀉、黏膜侵襲型發炎／血便或嘔吐為主的表現。群聚環境、食品處理不當、未煮熟食物與受污染水源增加暴露，但不是疾病機轉本身。藥物副作用、發炎性腸病、缺血或外科急腹症也可表現為急性腹瀉與腹痛，不能在病程持續、血便或局部腹膜刺激徵象時一概歸為腸胃炎。
cond.acute_gastroenteritis.etiology_en: Acute gastroenteritis is a syndrome with several etiologies. Viruses transmitted by the fecal–oral route—especially norovirus, rotavirus, adenovirus, and astrovirus—are common causes; microscopic stool or vomit particles can reach the mouth through person-to-person contact or contaminated food, water, and surfaces. Bacteria such as Salmonella, Campylobacter, Shigella, and pathogenic E. coli and a range of parasites can also cause infectious gastroenteritis. Some foodborne outbreaks instead result from ingestion of preformed bacterial toxins or chemical contaminants and do not require invasive organisms multiplying in the bowel. The pathogen and its virulence factors shape secretory watery diarrhea, mucosal-invasive inflammatory or bloody diarrhea, or vomiting-predominant illness. Congregate settings, unsafe food handling, undercooked food, and contaminated water increase exposure but are not themselves the tissue mechanism. Medication effects, inflammatory bowel disease, ischemia, and surgical abdominal disease can mimic acute gastroenteritis, so persistent illness, blood in stool, or focal peritoneal signs require reconsideration rather than automatic attribution to an infection.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Viral Gastroenteritis — viral causes, nonviral gastroenteritis and fecal–oral spread (reviewed 2018-05); CDC: How Norovirus Spreads — person, food, water, surface and vomit-particle transmission (updated 2024-04-24)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Viral Gastroenteritis — viral causes, nonviral gastroenteritis and fecal–oral spread (reviewed 2018-05); CDC: How Norovirus Spreads — person, food, water, surface and vomit-particle transmission (updated 2024-04-24)

cond.acute_cholecystitis.etiology_zh: 急性結石性膽囊炎通常由膽結石或膽泥持續阻塞膽囊管引起。膽汁滯留與膽囊內壓升高造成膨脹、黏膜化學性刺激及壁面灌流下降，進而啟動發炎；阻塞若未解除，可進展為缺血、壞疽或穿孔。腸道細菌可能在受損與滯留的膽囊內續發增生，但細菌感染不是每一例的起始原因。無結石性膽囊炎則較常發生於重症、敗血症、重大創傷或手術、燒傷、休克、長期禁食或全靜脈營養時，膽囊低灌流、膽汁滯留與濃縮共同造成壁面損傷；它在重症患者中可缺少典型右上腹症狀。膽囊管阻塞與總膽管阻塞不同：黃疸合併發燒與右上腹痛需考慮膽管炎或總膽管結石，不能只標記為單純膽囊炎。
cond.acute_cholecystitis.etiology_en: Acute calculous cholecystitis usually begins when a gallstone or biliary sludge persistently obstructs the cystic duct. Retained bile and rising intraluminal pressure distend the gallbladder, cause chemical mucosal injury, and impair wall perfusion, initiating inflammation; ongoing obstruction can progress to ischemia, gangrene, or perforation. Enteric bacteria may secondarily proliferate in a damaged, stagnant gallbladder, but infection is not the initiating event in every case. Acute acalculous cholecystitis more often occurs with critical illness, sepsis, major trauma or surgery, burns, shock, prolonged fasting, or parenteral nutrition, where hypoperfusion, bile stasis, and concentration combine to injure the wall; classic right-upper-quadrant findings may be muted in critically ill patients. Cystic-duct obstruction is distinct from common-bile-duct obstruction: jaundice with fever and right-upper-quadrant pain should raise concern for cholangitis or choledocholithiasis rather than being labeled uncomplicated cholecystitis.

etiology_zh: NHS: Acute cholecystitis — calculous cystic-duct obstruction and acalculous categories (retrieved 2026-08); NCBI StatPearls: Acute Cholecystitis — obstruction, stasis, pressure ischemia, critical-illness and acalculous mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: NHS: Acute cholecystitis — calculous cystic-duct obstruction and acalculous categories (retrieved 2026-08); NCBI StatPearls: Acute Cholecystitis — obstruction, stasis, pressure ischemia, critical-illness and acalculous mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08)

cond.diverticular_disease.etiology_zh: 結腸憩室形成與結腸壁薄弱處、隨年齡改變的結締組織、腸壁肌肉與神經功能，以及節段性腔內壓力共同有關，但確切起始原因尚未完全確定；遺傳易感也有影響。大多數憩室本身不發炎且終生無症狀。所謂憩室病涵蓋憩室相關慢性症狀、出血、憩室炎與其併發症，這些不是同一機轉：出血多與憩室旁血管受損有關；憩室炎則是局部發炎，可能伴憩室壁微小或明顯穿孔、細菌與糞便滯留、菌相及免疫反應改變，但『食物顆粒堵住憩室』不是每例都已證實的單一原因。低纖維高紅肉飲食、缺乏活動、肥胖、吸菸及 NSAIDs 或類固醇使用與憩室炎或併發症風險相關，應描述為風險關聯，而不是已證明直接造成每一個憩室。
cond.diverticular_disease.etiology_en: Colonic diverticula likely arise through interacting weak points in the bowel wall, age-related connective-tissue change, altered colonic muscle or nerve function, and segmental intraluminal pressure, but the initiating cause is not fully established; genetic susceptibility also contributes. Most diverticula never become inflamed and remain asymptomatic. “Diverticular disease” includes chronic diverticula-associated symptoms, bleeding, diverticulitis, and complications, which do not share one mechanism. Bleeding generally reflects injury to vessels adjacent to a diverticulum, whereas diverticulitis is localized inflammation that may include micro- or macroperforation and possible contributions from retained stool or bacteria, altered microbiome, and immune responses; a food particle “blocking a pouch” is not a proven universal cause. Low-fiber/high-red-meat diets, inactivity, obesity, smoking, and NSAID or steroid exposure are associated with diverticulitis or complications and should be described as risk relationships rather than proven direct causes of every diverticulum.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Diverticular Disease — uncertain cause, genetic, lifestyle, microbiome, connective-tissue, neuromuscular and immune contributors (reviewed 2021-08); NHS: Diverticular disease and diverticulitis — pouch formation, inflammation and complication distinction (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Diverticular Disease — uncertain cause, genetic, lifestyle, microbiome, connective-tissue, neuromuscular and immune contributors (reviewed 2021-08); NHS: Diverticular disease and diverticulitis — pouch formation, inflammation and complication distinction (retrieved 2026-08)

cond.celiac_disease.etiology_zh: 乳糜瀉需要飲食麩質暴露與遺傳易感共同存在。患者幾乎都帶有 HLA-DQ2 或 HLA-DQ8，但這些基因型在人群中很常見，只有少數攜帶者發病，因此它們是必要背景而非單獨充分原因。小麥、大麥與黑麥中的麩質胜肽進入小腸後，在組織轉麩醯胺酶相關處理及 HLA 呈現下啟動適應性與先天免疫反應，造成上皮內淋巴球活化、絨毛損傷與吸收不良；停止麩質暴露通常可使黏膜修復。家族聚集、其他免疫相關基因及可能的早期感染、麩質攝取量與腸道環境被認為會調整何時及是否發病，但不是每位患者都有可辨識的第二觸發因子。乳糜瀉是免疫介導的全身性疾病，不等同 IgE 型小麥過敏，也不同於不造成典型小腸自體免疫損傷的非乳糜瀉麩質敏感。
cond.celiac_disease.etiology_en: Celiac disease requires both dietary gluten exposure and genetic susceptibility. Nearly all affected people carry HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8, but these variants are common in the general population and only a minority of carriers develop disease, so they provide a necessary background rather than a sufficient cause on their own. Gluten peptides from wheat, barley, and rye reach the small bowel and, after tissue-transglutaminase–related processing and HLA presentation, activate adaptive and innate immune pathways, intraepithelial lymphocytes, villous injury, and malabsorption; removing gluten usually permits mucosal healing. Family clustering, other immune-related genes, and possible modifying influences from early infections, gluten exposure, and the intestinal environment may affect whether and when disease emerges, but a second trigger is not identifiable in every patient. Celiac disease is a systemic immune-mediated disorder, not an IgE-mediated wheat allergy, and it differs from non-celiac gluten sensitivity, which does not produce the characteristic autoimmune small-bowel injury.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Celiac Disease — gluten requirement, DQ2/DQ8 susceptibility and incomplete penetrance (reviewed 2020-10); NHS: Causes of coeliac disease — autoimmune villous injury, genetic and environmental contributors (reviewed 2023-03-31)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of Celiac Disease — gluten requirement, DQ2/DQ8 susceptibility and incomplete penetrance (reviewed 2020-10); NHS: Causes of coeliac disease — autoimmune villous injury, genetic and environmental contributors (reviewed 2023-03-31)

cond.lactose_intolerance.etiology_zh: 乳糖不耐源於小腸乳糖酶不足造成乳糖吸收不良；未消化的乳糖增加腸腔滲透負荷，並在結腸被細菌發酵產生氣體與代謝物。只有當這些變化在攝取乳糖後產生腹脹、腹痛、排氣或腹瀉等症狀時，才稱乳糖不耐；乳糖吸收不良可沒有症狀，嚴重度也受攝取量、與其他食物同食、腸道菌相及個人感受影響。最常見病因是遺傳決定的乳糖酶非持續性，使酵素活性在嬰兒期後逐漸下降；小腸感染、乳糜瀉、Crohn disease、手術、藥物或放射治療造成黏膜損傷時，可出現可能可逆的續發性乳糖酶缺乏。早產兒可有暫時性發育不足，先天性完全缺乏則極罕見。乳糖不耐是碳水化合物消化問題，不是對牛奶蛋白的免疫過敏；後者可造成蕁麻疹、喘鳴或過敏性休克，安全處置不同。
cond.lactose_intolerance.etiology_en: Lactose intolerance results when low small-intestinal lactase activity causes lactose malabsorption. Undigested lactose adds an osmotic load and is fermented by colonic bacteria, producing gas and metabolites. The term lactose intolerance applies only when these processes cause symptoms such as bloating, pain, flatulence, or diarrhea after lactose exposure; lactose malabsorption can be asymptomatic, and symptom severity also depends on dose, co-ingested food, microbiome, and individual sensitivity. The most common cause is genetically programmed lactase nonpersistence, in which enzyme activity declines after infancy. Small-bowel infection, celiac disease, Crohn disease, surgery, medications, or radiation injury can cause secondary lactase deficiency that may improve when the mucosa heals. Premature infants may have transient developmental deficiency, while complete congenital lactase deficiency is very rare. Lactose intolerance is a carbohydrate-digestion problem, not an immune allergy to milk proteins; milk allergy can cause urticaria, wheeze, or anaphylaxis and has a different safety pathway.
